summary: preinstall script exfiltrates filesystem reconnaissance to webhook.site
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall lifecycle script (probe.js) reads /proc/mounts, enumerates /mnt, /var, /opt, walks /tmp/.yarn, and reads up to 2000 bytes of /var/task/node_modules/twilio-runtime/index.js from the installer host, then POSTs the collected data as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (https://webhook.site/5711fe0a-6437-47ae-9fd0-75d624c26467/mnt). The /var/task read specifically targets AWS Lambda deployment layouts, which commonly contain proprietary application code and embedded configuration. The behavior fires automatically at install time without user interaction and leaks build/host filesystem contents to an attacker-controlled collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
